context: Tests whether an agent audits CTAs on structure and measurability: competing primary buttons, dead links, friction, missing next step, shared endpoint, conflated offers, no attribution of inquiries, and states what it could not check.

checklist.name: Competing primary CTAs
checklist.description: Reports that the hero has two equally weighted primary buttons (free guide and book a call) plus a header button, so the first screen has no single primary action, and ties it to the brand's primary action being the intake call.

checklist.name: Dead CTA
checklist.description: Finds `href="#"` ('Learn more') as a dead control.

checklist.name: Friction counted
checklist.description: Counts the contact form: six required fields out of seven, including phone and company, a mailto link beside it, and compares with what an intake request needs; the home form asks only for an email but is labelled 'waiting list' while the hero promises a call.

checklist.name: No next step
checklist.description: Reports that neither page says what happens after sending or when, and that no confirmation is visible in the files; it states the confirmation mail was not checked.

checklist.name: Measurability
checklist.description: Notes that no form asks how the visitor heard of the practice, and that the inquiry log has an empty `via` and `why us` for 4 of 5 rows, so inquiries cannot be attributed to a channel. It does not claim any conversion rate.

checklist.name: Shared endpoint
checklist.description: Notices that the waiting-list form and the contact form both post to `/api/contact`, so the channel cannot be told apart afterwards, and proposes separate endpoints or a hidden source field.

checklist.name: Offers conflated
checklist.description: Notices that one select field mixes a free guide, a paid mediation and a newsletter in the same form, so the default action and the card's focus are muddled.

checklist.name: Conversation path
checklist.description: Evaluates the path for someone who wants to talk to a person (mailto, phone required on the form) and whether it is distinguishable from the waiting list.

checklist.name: Limits and proposals without invented copy
checklist.description: States what was not checked (live rendering, position on the first screen, confirmation mail, the target pages) and gives proposals without writing replacement wording as final, or says wording needs a check against the tone of voice.
